title: Data Stream as Disjoint Intervals
description: Maintain a summary of the data stream as a list of disjoint intervals.
pseudocode:
1. intervals = []
2. function addNum(val):
3.   idx = binarySearch(intervals, val)
4.   left = (idx > 0) ? intervals[idx-1] : null
5.   right = (idx < intervals.length) ? intervals[idx] : null
6.   if left and right and left[1]+1 == val and val+1 == right[0]: merge(left, right)
7.   else if left and val <= left[1]+1: left[1] = max(left[1], val)
8.   else if right and val >= right[0]-1: right[0] = min(right[0], val)
9.   else: intervals.splice(idx, 0, [val, val])

steps.note: Add non-adjacent 3, resulting in two intervals
